summary: Full end-to-end backend testing of e-procurement MVP: auth, masters (dept/cat/hs-code/product), vendor self-registration + approval + login, user management, budget create+approve, PR budget-violation rejection & multi-level approval + budget consumption, tender open+bid, PO merge from PR + approval + send, goods receipt updating PO/PR statuses, invoice submit+pay, LS document, company settings + Odoo mocked syncs, dashboard stats. 41/41 pytest tests passed against public preview URL.

minor.issue: 'note' is declared as a function argument but not wrapped in Body/Query; FastAPI treats it as query parameter. Works, but frontend must pass note as query string (?note=...), not JSON body. Consider making it a Pydantic model for consistency.

When receipt is completed, backend overwrites PO.status to 'completed' even if PO was previously 'sent'. Then subsequent send/approve won't work. Non-blocking for current flow but semantically mixing 'shipping_status' with 'status'.
Not restricted to admin for GET (any authenticated user, incl. vendor, can read settings). Vendor should probably not see internal Odoo config.
Update/delete endpoints do not enforce admin/procurement role (only create_department does). Any authenticated user incl. vendor can delete master data.
No ownership check that PO.vendor_id == vendor's own id; any vendor could submit invoice against another vendor's PO.

action_items: (Optional) Restrict update/delete on master data (departments, categories, hs-codes, products) to admin/procurement roles.
(Optional) Enforce vendor ownership check on POST /api/vendor-portal/invoices (po.vendor_id must equal user's vendor_id).
(Optional) Convert 'note' query-param approvals to Pydantic body for cleaner API contract.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.109).
routes_procurement.py > 500 lines — consider splitting into pr.py, po.py, tender.py, budget.py.

_budget_available only checks dept-level budget with product_id=None when product-specific budget missing; existing PO consumption is not written back when goods receipt updates or when PR is rejected after approval (used_amount never decrements).
CORS: allow_origins uses only FRONTEND_URL env; deployed preview relies on regex — acceptable but production origin list should be explicit.

Approvals allow admin override (correct), but role check uses `user['role'] not in (step['role'], 'admin')`; step['role']='approver' works. However there is no approval_limit enforcement despite user model having 'approval_limit' field.
Password policy: no minimum length validation on RegisterIn / UserIn / vendor default_password.

seed_data_creation: Test creates: 1 department, 1 category, 1 HS code, 1 product, 1 requester user, 1 budget (100jt IDR approved), 1 PR (45jt approved through multi-level), 1 vendor (self-registered + approved), 1 tender (open + bid), 1 PO (BONDED, approved+sent), 1 goods receipt (completed), 1 invoice (paid), 1 LS document. All prefixed with TEST_ where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pytest -n 0 (default pytest.ini uses -n 2 loadscope which breaks module-scoped STATE dict shared across classes). Test file is /app/backend/tests/test_eprocurement_flow.py. All 41 tests currently pass. Backend routes are split into routes_*.py files. Admin override works on all approval levels. Budget consumption happens only on PR full approval (not PO).
